description: Risk score (0-100) for a token. A Solana mint (base58) gets mint/freeze authority and holder concentration; a 0x address is checked on Robinhood Chain (same as rugcheck_robinhood). Automated on-chain checks, not financial advice.

exclude.description: Token accounts to leave out of the holder check, such as a pool or bonding curve

mint.description: Solana token mint (base58) or Robinhood Chain token contract (0x...)

name: rugcheck
title: Rug-check a Solana or Robinhood Chain token
